neighbours.label: a group or work about to be credited to its leader or author: the token before 'led by' / 'by <name>' (orchestra led by, force led by, Book by Author)
fire: Last night we heard the city choir led by a visiting conductor.
In 1864 a cavalry force led by General Sheridan raided the valley.
The research team led by Dr. Okafor published its results.
We watched a jazz ensemble led by an elderly trumpeter.
Rescuers joined a search party led by two local guides.
The expedition led by Shackleton never reached the pole.
Back then a rebel army led by a former priest held the town.
Fans cheered for the national team led by its young captain.
quiet: Last night we heard the city choir sing three carols.
In 1864 a cavalry force camped quietly in the valley.
The research team published its results in spring.
We watched a jazz ensemble play until midnight.
Rescuers joined a search party at the trailhead.
The expedition never reached the pole that winter.
Back then a rebel army held the town for months.
Fans cheered loudly for the national team at kickoff.

notes: Card: peaks on the last token before 'by <name>' (War II| by Donovan, Orchestra| led by Mehta, Confederate| force), and the - output direction promotes ' by', ' led', ' authored'. Probe: a book title before 'by' scored ~0.04, ' led' ~0.22, so the test centres on groups led by someone.
